title: Which Movie Genre Is Your Life?
description: If cameras followed you around, what kind of movie would they be making? Roll film and find out!

results.description: High energy, quick decisions, zero hesitation. Your life moves at full throttle and you like it that way — there's always another sequel in production.
Endlessly curious about how the world actually works. You collect fascinating truths the way others collect souvenirs, and talking to you is an education.
Quietly original with impeccable taste. You find meaning in small moments others rush past, and your perspective is the one people remember later.
Life at full volume, feelings fully expressed. You bring theatrical joy to ordinary days, and around you, even a Tuesday can become a showstopper.
Sharp-eyed and three clues ahead. You notice what others miss, love a good puzzle, and your instincts about people are almost unsettlingly accurate.
Warm-hearted and quietly convinced the universe is conspiring in everyone's favor. You believe in great timing, grand gestures, and happy endings — and you're usually right.
